title: Auto-gain (X05) + every position counts the same (X04)
hypothesis: X05 fixes the EMG size change between sessions and X04 makes the fit care about small positions; they address different causes, so together they may add up. Risk: interaction (both re-weight what the model sees at the weak positions).
motivation: Stage C step 1: the two best single changes in Stage A (both passed criteria 1-2). Launched in parallel with Stage B to save time; interpreted only if both are confirmed in Stage B.
